clips.title: The story
paras: Farstrider Lodge is a hunting outpost in southeastern Loch Modan. Its architecture appears to be high elven, while its residents include the high elf Vyrin Swiftwind, dwarves, and humans. Hunters and travelers come here for training, supplies, and work in the surrounding wilds.

Farstrider Lodge stands apart from the sturdy stone buildings typical of Khaz Modan. Its architecture suggests high elven craftsmanship. Vyrin Swiftwind is the only known high elf still residing here, alongside dwarves and humans. The lodge's founder and date of construction are not established.
